title: Exodus details written by someone living in New Kingdom Egypt

tellings.quote: uh the the details that are in the Exodus story when you're looking back could have only been written by somebody who was alive in Egypt during the time of the Exodus,

plain: The details in the Exodus story could only have been written by someone who was living in Egypt when the Exodus happened. Luke Caverns, a researcher who argues that the pyramids are not what we think, makes this case to Michels as his own reading of the Bible, the King James Version of 1611 among the texts he relies on. If he is right, the story would be a memory from that time rather than something made up later.
